notes.title: The Final Update
notes.notes:
CHAMPIONS!

What a long road we have walked together.

From our initial reveal...

[previewyoutube=NrcW0Cl_vAQ;full][/previewyoutube]
To our Early Access launch...

[previewyoutube=qlLggsjGbo0;full][/previewyoutube]
And the seven FULL worlds of v1.0...

[previewyoutube=JBlTTW3RRtw;full][/previewyoutube]
Brought into Virtual Reality...

[previewyoutube=JK6s0Pn5MDM;full][/previewyoutube]
And finally... The Black Labyrinth...

[previewyoutube=6MoB-JFH-jQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The last seven years have been MAGICAL.

This final update adds a Hordes of Evil Endless Arena to The Black Labyrinth, so that you may have one final romp with its enemies and punchify them into a fine red mist.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/1eec85f358fd6411d80d9005a2655d32d89720e6.jpg
On behalf of Leon, Simon, Andrew, the New Blood team and myself (Dave) 

We'd like to thank you for joining us on this journey to vanquish evil!

You may rest now, Champions. THE UNIVERSE AWAITS.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34227/AMID_EVIL__CHAMPION_EDITION/

notes.title: Hotfix - Build 2617
notes.notes:
There was a patch today with the following changes:

Main game:


 Fixed codex description on Axe of the Black Labyrinth
 Fixed FATAL ERROR on quitting game with RT enabled


Black Labyrinth:


 Removed 'continue' option in main menu if you haven't played the BL yet
 Made hard difficulty path a little easier to see
 Lowered Boss Bomb explosion radius
 Lowered Labyrinth Knights HP slightly
 Fixed Voidsplitter not 1-hitting Labyrinth Knights
 Fixed Thunder Spirit getting stuck sometimes
 Fixed Extra planet that would show up when swapping weapon sets
 Fixed destructible wall save bugs in all levels
 Fixed big door in 'the wall' that would sometimes close on the player
 Fixed gold key door in 'the wall' that would sometimes permanently lock
 Fixed moving spikes not saving in 'the hole'
 Fixed water slide effects not saving properly in 'the hole'
 Fixed falling pillars in 'the chamber'
 Fixed many out of bounds areas

notes.title: Amid Evil's RTX update shows us an exciting potential future for ray tracing
notes.notes:
Launched in 2019, Amid Evil is one of the best shooters to emerge from the retro-FPS revival. Combining colourful and creative levels with some incredible, Hexen-inspired magical melee weapons (including the phenomenal Star of Torment, one of my favourite FPS weapons in ages), it sits proudly alongside New Blood Interactive's other "boomer shooters" like the incomparable Dusk and the Early Access phenomenon Ultrakill...
                Read more.

notes.title: RTX Beta Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/98bd9afacbe4653391af464d0c06ebe9a490abcc.gif

Champions (with graphical processing to spare) you've been waiting for THIS.
Our FINAL round of RTX beta testing has BEGUN.

After nearly a YEAR since we first put ray tracing features into the game, we're almost ready for FULL LAUNCH thanks to our friends at Nvidia. 

Before you hop in, we highly recommend you grab the latest drivers from the GeForce website!

But not before we get one more round of feedback and testing from YOU.

So what can you expect?!
Accurate enemy shadows

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/be799caf948a75898d3d276a711cae156ea21d2a.gif

Fully accurate reflections

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/45815610ae06679625eaf7111d0026da3663f3af.gif

Pixel perfect geometry shadows

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/91fa54b5e94a18441b86a292c7f0386b3e95f5a4.gif

New features like LIGHT BOOST

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/838b61126dcacff923b113b3e155a7c48ab0ce9b.gif

And REFLECTION BOOST!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/7d2f9d0c0513cf84393f41daeedca5888d11161c.gif

So what do we want you to test?[olist]

 Can you get the game to CRASH?! If so, how! Reproduce those steps and send them to us!

 Are there any areas where you get MEGA performance drops? Not normal perf drops due to an abundance of lights and shadows and enemies (that will happen) but places where performance just seems... WRONG.

 New BUGS! Do you get any issues with levels or enemies that aren't present in the base game? Let us know so we can fix them!
[/olist]
You can get on the RTX Beta testing branch by selecting it from the BETAS tab in game properties!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019141/137b96759e5821e1e84746d230cc4081e0fc0fec.png

Now, I know what some of you are saying.
"Voice of the Ancients! (or Dave) I don't have an RTX GPU!"

"I just want to know more about... THE BLACK LABYRINTH",

Well, my Champions... BEHOLD.

NEW LEVELS

https://i.imgur.com/jE2owbW.gif

NEW ENEMIES

https://i.imgur.com/tYbSt6B.gif

And a trip...

TO THE SHADOW REALM

https://i.imgur.com/lTrBp79.gif

For those of you who've been living under a low poly rock and somehow DIDN'T KNOW we were making a FULL PREQUEL EXPANSION to AMID EVIL, here's the original Black Labyrinth reveal trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2--kql5YFww
And don't forget to keep up with our #ScreenshotSaturday development posts (almost) every week!

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We're looking forward to seeing all your screenshots, videos, performance reports and bugs!

And then our full RTX + DLSS launch coming... SOON™
May your framerates remain HIGH and your visuals stay DANK.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/

notes.title: AMID Update #4
notes.notes:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AbleVagueAssassinbug-size_restricted.gif
Welcome back, Champions! 

We hope you've survived The Solar Solstice, because more trials await you... and you can partake in them... RIGHT NOW.

That's right, Update #4 brings with it a brand new Hordes of Evil arena as well as a new hub world for Hordes of Evil.

It's big. It's purple. It's got dank ambient music... you'll dig it.

Hordes of Evil arenas will now also feature enemies from ALL FOUR available episodes. So prepare thy butts.

https://media.giphy.com/media/TIiBXyM504flozqmS6/giphy.gif

But more importantly...

This new update has completely revamped the enemy AI

You'll find enemies will now be less aggressive but more tactical. 
You'll notice more strafing, side stepping, backpedaling and ranged attacks. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/OOSJGpnqWOM6VtJI94/giphy.gif

You'll especially start to see ranged enemies use new attack patterns and in general most combat encounters in the game will now feel much more dynamic and varied. 
Not to mention (potentially) more difficult.

https://media.giphy.com/media/Bzkoa3SuI6HN2u4BDj/giphy.gif

This AI change makes the game feel A LOT different, and we think you're gonna like it.

We've also made significant changes to the enemies and weapons you encounter Episode 3 - so go replay it! We think you'll appreciate those changes as well

Hmm, but there was something else...

Oh yeah, YOU CAN NOW REBIND SOUL MODE AND FIRE IT INDEPENDENTLY. 
THAT'S RIGHT. WE GAVE IN TO YOUR DEMANDS. 
DON'T SAY WE NEVER DID ANYTHING FOR YOU!

https://media.giphy.com/media/20yCpxzLFZaawO3Zgt/giphy.gif
Note: this is not how the game was intended to be played - but we're all for options.

Full patch notes HERE: https://steamcommunity.com/app/673130/discussions/0/2949168687311359737/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/

As always, don't forget to drop into Discord.gg/NewBlood to chat with us and keep up to date on all the latest - and also check out our brand new developer page to see what's up with ALL of our games as well as our latest recommendations.

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NewBlood

notes.title: AMID Update #3
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/9P95y3adOB6kSRDnrh/giphy.gif
Warriors! We've just released the third update for AMID EVIL!

Changes include...

An upgrade to Unreal Engine 4.19 (we didn't break anything!)
Flight mode less slippery (like an eagle)
Insta death torches fixed (sorry)
Apostle's Shrine lift bug fixed (no squish)
Weapon switch while firing is now a thing (you're welcome)
Getting out of water is now easier (you're very welcome)
Hordes of Evil end score now front and center (haha u ded)
New water death for Azure Orb overkill (they'll float too)
Flying enemy AI won't get in your face (t'was broken)
More souls required for Hard and Evil, less souls required for Easy (good balance)
Holding fire won't activate soul mode 'til your next fire (no more accidents!)

The quality of life improvements such as the soul changes, new flying AI and NOT being able to accidentally trigger soul mode (it happens to thhe best of us) really change the way the game feels at its core - we think you'll dig it!

But we couldn't keep improving and tweaking AMID EVIL without your feedback so... 

KEEP. IT. COMING.

Until next time, warriors...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/

notes.title: AMID Update #2
notes.notes:
https://media.giphy.com/media/iDLuTvPOEwv9skzzB1/giphy.gif
Warriors! We've just released the second update for AMID EVIL!

Changes include...

Weapon switching should now cycle properly (neat)
Weapon fire and impact sound improvements (BEEFIER)
Smooth camera movement on stairs (smoooth)
Trails for enemies falling into black holes (looks real cool)
New animation for enemies falling into black holes (also looks cool)
Enemies no longer get lost (nice)
Fixed not going to next episode after dying in gateway bug (whoops)
Can't get stuck inside lifts (yay)
New Load screen tips (useful!)
Cheat codex fixed (people still won't read it)
New cheat: AEXTREME - Actually makes weapons fire fast
AEROBICS changed to AELYMPICS
New cheat: AEBABY - Soul mode toggle (infinite duration)
New cheat: AEMEMES - memes (memes)
Other misc bugfixes (memes)

But wait - we've also added the much requested...

COLOUR THEORY SLIDER!

https://twitter.com/DaveOshry/status/976593013886472192

So now those of you who thought AMID EVIL was a bit TOO COLOURFUL or just want to mess around and play AE in Black & White... you can!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/e5daf4bc8f2073707c7e991d26369609554f2ab8.jpg

There's also a whole bunch of fun cheats you can use to mess with the way AMID EVIL looks so... use em! (they're in the Codex)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/401436f8594bbe1c2914a0951787dd9319b04951.jpg
(don't do this please)

In addition to all this is WARRIOR MODE which (much like DUSK's INTRUDER MODE) will have you start each level with ONLY the Axe of the Black Labyrinth. (Like a true warrior!)

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31019141/d208c50bea204519c69b501d86928f9310fd8430.jpg

YOU'RE WELCOME.

Full thread HERE: http://steamcommunity.com/app/673130/discussions/0/2949168687311359737/

No go forth... and SLAY   ːLoreleiː

http://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/

notes.title: AMID Update #1
notes.notes:
https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DeliriousWellinformedCuttlefish-max-14mb.gif
Warriors! We've just released the first update for AMID EVIL!

Changes include...

 New Planets for the Celestial Claw
 Planets randomize a lot nicer now, you won't get the same planet twice.
 Earth shows up less frequently, so you can commit genocide LESS.
 Voltride casts Chain Lightning on overkill now. (also a cool Steely Dan song)
 Frame cap slider can now go to UNLIMITED (power!!!!)
 Weapon keys can be rebound.
 Reset to default should actually do something.
 Can change HUD message size in HUD options.
 Mana numbers on the HUD gotta go fast now instead of slow
 Asynchronous saving added so speedrunners won't get angry at me. (no hitches on saving).
 Axe does 5 MORE DAMAGE, yay. (this will actually 1 shot many enemies) 
 Sword projectile does more damage on direct hit. Pass thru damage is the same.
 Some enemies will enter their pain state (flinch) more often.
 Achievements should activate when you get level awards. 

https://media.giphy.com/media/93fnnPlTgFFzSWybCE/giphy.gif
Oh and the Axe of the Black Labyrinth now ACTUALLY works as a boat propeller

YOU'RE WELCOME.

Full thread HERE: http://steamcommunity.com/app/673130/discussions/0/2949168687311359737/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/673130/AMID_EVIL/
